name: Makita XCU06
blurb: Oregon lists XCU05 and XCU06 with two 3/8″ low-profile .043″ chains: 8″ / 33 drive links (R33) and 10″ / 40 drive links (R40).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints XCU05, XCU06 as one pair with two chains: R33 (8″, 33 drive links, .043″, 3/8″ low profile) and R40 (10″, 40 drive links, .043″, 3/8″ low profile). It does not say which length belongs to which model number. This is a different table from the XCU03 / XCU04 manual, which lists 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars. No file size is printed.

bars.note: Oregon prints R33 under XCU05, XCU06: 8″ bar, 33 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not assign this length to XCU05 or XCU06 alone. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints R40 under XCU05, XCU06: 10″ bar, 40 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not assign this length to XCU05 or XCU06 alone. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 9 Nov 2026. The row restates the model line Oregon prints for this saw. Oregon does not print a file size on that line.
notice: Oregon prints both chains under XCU05 and XCU06 together. Read the bar stamp before you pick 33 or 40 drive links.
